newsitem.title: USA: Canandaigua Wine sees Q3 EPS at $0.42.
newsitem.headline: Canandaigua Wine sees Q3 EPS at $0.42.

text.p: Canandaigua Wine said it expects net income for the third quarter to be about $8.3 million or $0.42 per share compared to $10.4 million or $0.52 per share last year.
The company said third quarter net sales were $317.7 million, an increase of $32.1 million compared with last year.
Unit volume of its branded beverage alcohol products for the third quarter was 16.3 million cases, a 6.2 percent increase as compared to the previous year.

Canandaigua expects to report complete results of operations for the three months ended November 30 in January 1997. The company also said that as of today's date it has repurchased a total of 785,200 shares of its Class A common stock.
